scope: Source-only acceptance of production commit/integration/push preparation controls. Not actual production-source, commit, GREEN/MASTER-result or diagnostic-finalization acceptance.
checks: Each mode requires accepted preparation review and exact bindings plus fresh host observation.
Commit requires accepted production and GREEN result reviews, full candidate membership/hashes, protected files/indexes and exact base refs.
Private temporary index reads pinned base; exact changed names and blobs are verified before sole-parent commit-tree and new branch update. Real indexes remain unchanged.

Integration requires actual commit review, current candidate/protection checks, branch master at base, remote base, sole parent and clean target paths; only ff-only merge; snapshots original index/source maps and verifies unrelated index and staged-state preservation.
Push requires accepted actual MASTER result, same GREEN total, actual master branch/ref, approved single fetch/push endpoint and nonforce remote relationship.
Before push, complete actual/tested/pinned src/test membership and hashes, exact historical source/index maps, full preserved baseline, and every MASTER pin are checked.
Normal nonforce push followed by exact tracking/remote verification. All subprocess mutations use check=True or checked output; errors stop subsequent actions.
pending: Actual GREEN and MASTER result acceptance.
Separate finalization controls have reported findings and are not accepted by this record.
